title: Add a column to a table
prompt: Add a nullable `deleted_at` text column to the `notes` table in schema.sql.
check: rm -f db.sqlite && sqlite3 db.sqlite < schema.sql && sqlite3 db.sqlite < seed.sql && [ "$(sqlite3 db.sqlite 'select count(*) from notes')" = 3 ] && sqlite3 db.sqlite 'select deleted_at from notes limit 1' >/dev/null
